title: Design Kit Jig — Reusable Control Harness, Playback, Trace, Prompt & Open Skill
short_summary: Reusable Slides-matched Design Kit Jig control harness with matte backplates, 9 styles x 5 donor variant notches, accordion Left TOC, drag-scrub inspector, interactive Playback autopilot cursor, strokeless Red Record MP4 walkthroughs, Trace .md viewer, live rendered Prompt HTML+CSS copy, and 100% standalone Open window launching.
when_to_use: Install once in Jetski, then ask Jetski repeatedly across any project to wrap a component, app, landing page, 3D scene, shader, or slide deck in the Design Kit Jig, launch the harness in the right-hand Artifact Pane, or run playback, recording, trace, prompt, and standalone open flows.
summary: Installs, scaffolds, launches, and operates the canonical Slides-matched Design Kit Jig control harness with matte backplates, 9 folder-backed styles (clone through retro), 5 donor variant notches per style, UI library and dark/light theme switching, expandable accordion Left TOC, tactile right-hand drag-scrub inspector, interactive Playback autopilot cursor, strokeless Red Record MP4 walkthrough capture, unified Trace markdown viewer, live rendered Prompt HTML+CSS clipboard copy, and 100% standalone Open window launching.
